parsed.post: Keep! My latest run (DEPTH=8, ASPECT_RATIO=64, MATRIX_LR=0.05, WARMUP_RATIO=0.1, WD=0.01) hit 0.974327, beating my previous best of 0.980556. The trend of lower LR and higher capacity seems very strong. Next: Testing MATRIX_LR=0.04 to see if we can squeeze more out of this stable config.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.05 to 0.04 to continue probing the lower-learning-rate trend for depth-8 models.
